newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota launches remodelled Mark II Wagon.
newsitem.headline: Toyota launches remodelled Mark II Wagon.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday it had launched a remodelled Mark II Qualis Wagon, a station wagon version of its mainstay Mark II saloon.

The new model went on sale on Wednesday with a monthly sales target of 4,000 units, with prices starting at 2.40 million yen for a two-wheel drive model and 2.62 million yen for a four-wheel drive model.
The wagons come with either 3.0-litre or 2.5-litre V-6 engines, or a 2.2-litre in-line four twin-cam engine.
